notes.text: Assigning NPCs to players should be possible within the scene preview panel, where it should happen instantly since no work needs to be done until the scene is transitioned to.
SERIOUS BUG:  Scenes on deck are being scrambled:  Returning to Elysium shows "Elysium" selected, but loaded the Fire Sale Chantry scene I was just departing.

Player assignments as NPCs should NEVER persist between scenes. If a scene is returned to and that character was playing themselves, or was playing a different NPC, the assignment they had at the scene they are returning to must be restored.

Ensure that all communication between the Dashboard and posts to the player map app (as well as the Deck of Complications) do not involve unnecessary interaction with TTS, as ANY interaction between the Dashboard and TTS causes noticeable performance lag.
"Ensure scenes are preloaded" reminder should appear during first "PLAY" phase at the start of a new session, NOT during Intermission.

There is no feedback on the Dashboard when session feedback XP is awarded via the buttons during the play phase.  Buttons should highlight or visually indicate that they have been clicked when the corresponding XP has been awarded to that player.

Error upon attempting to assign an NPC to a PC, referring to line 1811 of state.ttslua:

-1 [Global] Lua Error <executeScript>: Global:(37873,4-43): invalid value (table) at index 2 in table for 'concat'
    at concat
    at S.setStateVal
    at applyCommand (local)
    at Dash.apply
    at GlobalDashboardScenesApply
    at
Advancement from INTERMISSION to PLAY should not be permitted before the onboarding sequence has been run (i.e. the asset bundle load, the XML refresh, and the seating triggers)

After experimentally awarding feedback XP using the controls presented on the Storyteller Dashboard, a subsequent reload of the save (before the XP was awarded) provided me with no controls to award feedback XP.  The source of truth on whether XP has been awarded should be the actual XP awarded to the PCs; it should not be something tracked by the Dashboard independently of the reality in-game.

Upon switching the music via the dropdown in the scene preview panel, the selected option did not change and remained showing the default scene audio. Volume for both the music and the ambient audio both display zero, instead of the actual volume of the tracks for the scene.
Upon dropping a group onto a category to move them to the category, the group remained floating above the category, as if the drag entity wasn't properly cleared.
The "New Group" button should be changed to a simple "+" button, and relocated to beside the header for the "Unsorted" group.
